soru: Kalıcı homoloji (persistent homology) tabanlı topolojik optimizasyon, makine öğrenmesinde topolojik düzenlileştirme ve ilgili algoritmik yöntemler üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?
istem:
Research question: Kalıcı homoloji (persistent homology) tabanlı topolojik optimizasyon, makine öğrenmesinde topolojik düzenlileştirme ve ilgili algoritmik yöntemler üzerine en önemli çalışmalar ve açık problemler neler?

Cutoff date: 2026-02-24. Only works published BEFORE this date count.

List the 30 most important works (papers) for this research question that were published before the cutoff date, in order of importance (most important first) — the kind a careful expert survey published right after the cutoff would cite. Give each with its arXiv id and/or DOI.

You MUST research this with web search rather than answer from memory: search for the important works, and verify each listed work's title, publication date and identifier on the web (e.g. arxiv.org, doi.org, the publisher or DBLP page) before including it.

When you are done, reply with ONLY a JSON object in this form (no other text):
{"calismalar": [{"sira": 1, "baslik": "exact title", "yil": 2020, "arxiv_id": "arXiv id or null", "doi": "DOI or null", "gerekce": "one sentence on why this work is important"}]}
with exactly 30 items. If you do not know an identifier, use null instead of guessing.

calismalar.baslik: Optimizing persistent homology based functions
calismalar.gerekce: Gives a general framework for gradients of persistence-based functions, based on o-minimal/semi-algebraic geometry, and proves stochastic subgradient descent converges; it is the reference theory for topological optimization.

calismalar.baslik: A Framework for Differential Calculus on Persistence Barcodes
calismalar.gerekce: Uses diffeology to define differentiability of maps into and out of barcode space, with a chain rule, which puts gradient descent through barcodes on a rigorous footing.

calismalar.baslik: A Topology Layer for Machine Learning
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced a differentiable persistent-homology layer for level-set and edge filtrations, and made topological regularization and topological priors common in ML.

calismalar.baslik: Continuation of Point Clouds via Persistence Diagrams
calismalar.gerekce: First work to differentiate persistence diagrams with respect to point clouds and optimize toward a target diagram; this is the foundation of the vanilla topological gradient.

calismalar.baslik: Connectivity-Optimized Representation Learning via Persistent Homology
calismalar.gerekce: Proved that a persistence-based connectivity loss is differentiable and used it to shape autoencoder latent spaces, an early milestone in topological regularization of representations.

calismalar.baslik: Topological Autoencoders
calismalar.gerekce: Proposed a differentiable topological loss that keeps the multi-scale connectivity of the input in the latent space; widely used as a baseline for topology-preserving representation learning.

calismalar.baslik: A Topological Regularizer for Classifiers via Persistent Homology
calismalar.gerekce: First to penalize the topological complexity of a classifier's decision boundary with persistent homology, including an efficient gradient computation.

calismalar.baslik: Topology-Preserving Deep Image Segmentation
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced a differentiable persistence-diagram-matching loss that makes segmentations match the Betti numbers of the ground truth; this started topology-aware segmentation.

calismalar.baslik: A Topological Loss Function for Deep-Learning based Image Segmentation using Persistent Homology
calismalar.gerekce: Adds a persistent-homology loss that encodes known Betti-number priors to deep segmentation networks, and showed it works in medical imaging.

calismalar.baslik: Topological Function Optimization for Continuous Shape Matching
calismalar.gerekce: Early practical method that optimizes functions on shapes with persistence-based objectives, showing that topological optimization can be used in geometry processing.

calismalar.baslik: Topological Optimization with Big Steps
calismalar.gerekce: Uses the cycles and chains from the persistence computation to spread gradients over large parts of the domain, cutting the number of optimization steps by about an order of magnitude and addressing the sparse-gradient problem.

calismalar.baslik: A Fast and Robust Method for Global Topological Functional Optimization
calismalar.gerekce: Replaces unstable, costly topological backpropagation with a faster and more robust scheme that finds better optima.

calismalar.baslik: A Gradient Sampling Algorithm for Stratified Maps with Applications to Topological Data Analysis
calismalar.gerekce: Extends gradient sampling to stratifiably smooth functions, giving convergence guarantees for non-smooth persistence objectives.

calismalar.baslik: Diffeomorphic interpolation for efficient persistence-based topological optimization
calismalar.gerekce: Turns sparse topological gradients into smooth diffeomorphic vector fields, which allows large-scale topological optimization with subsampling.

calismalar.baslik: Topologically Faithful Image Segmentation via Induced Matching of Persistence Barcodes
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced the Betti matching loss, which uses induced matchings to compare topological features in a spatially correct way and fixes the spatial errors of earlier topology losses.

calismalar.baslik: Differentiability and Optimization of Multiparameter Persistent Homology
calismalar.gerekce: Extends the differentiability and optimization framework from one-parameter to multiparameter persistence descriptors.

calismalar.baslik: Topologically Regularized Data Embeddings
calismalar.gerekce: Proposes general topological losses that push data embeddings toward a chosen topological model, such as a given number of clusters or loops.

calismalar.baslik: Learning Topology-Preserving Data Representations
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced RTD-AE, which minimizes Representation Topology Divergence to preserve topology in dimensionality reduction, with theoretical guarantees.

calismalar.baslik: clDice - a Novel Topology-Preserving Loss Function for Tubular Structure Segmentation
calismalar.gerekce: A cheap skeleton-based differentiable loss that preserves topology up to homotopy equivalence; a widely used alternative to persistence-based losses.

calismalar.baslik: Topology-Aware Segmentation Using Discrete Morse Theory
calismalar.gerekce: Uses discrete Morse theory to find the global structures that matter for topology and trains on them, making topology-aware segmentation more efficient and spatially accurate.

calismalar.baslik: Topology-Aware Surface Reconstruction for Point Clouds
calismalar.gerekce: Puts persistence-diagram constraints into surface reconstruction, an example of topological priors used in geometric optimization.

calismalar.baslik: PersLay: A Neural Network Layer for Persistence Diagrams and New Graph Topological Signatures
calismalar.gerekce: A general differentiable layer for persistence diagrams that covers most vectorizations and makes it possible to learn topological features end to end.

calismalar.baslik: PLLay: Efficient Topological Layer based on Persistence Landscapes
calismalar.gerekce: A differentiable topological layer built on persistence landscapes for arbitrary filtrations, with stability guarantees against noise.

calismalar.baslik: Neural Persistence: A Complexity Measure for Deep Neural Networks Using Algebraic Topology
calismalar.gerekce: Applies persistent homology to network weights to measure model complexity, which led to topological analysis and regularization of the models themselves.

calismalar.baslik: Topological Graph Neural Networks
calismalar.gerekce: Introduced TOGL, a layer with learnable filtrations that adds persistent homology to GNNs and is provably more expressive than message passing.

calismalar.baslik: Large Scale computation of Means and Clusters for Persistence Diagrams using Optimal Transport
calismalar.gerekce: Recasts diagram metrics as entropy-regularized optimal transport, giving differentiable, GPU-scalable diagram distances that later topological losses use.

calismalar.baslik: A Survey of Topological Machine Learning Methods
calismalar.gerekce: Key survey of topological ML, including topological losses and regularization, which lists the field's open challenges.

calismalar.baslik: Stability of persistence diagrams
calismalar.gerekce: The bottleneck stability theorem; it underlies the Lipschitz and convergence results for persistence-based losses.

calismalar.baslik: Topological persistence and simplification
calismalar.gerekce: Founding paper on persistent homology and persistence-based topological simplification, the original notion behind topological optimization.

calismalar.baslik: Vines and vineyards by updating persistence in linear time
calismalar.gerekce: Updates persistence pairings under simplex transpositions; the big-step methods and stratified methods that track changing orderings during optimization rely on it.
